name: Forced leave register
script:
# Validate dates
if not doc.start_date or not doc.end_date:
    frappe.throw("Start Date and End Date are required")

# Use stored days if available
total_days = doc.days

# Fallback calculation if days empty
if not total_days:
    total_days = frappe.utils.date_diff(doc.end_date, doc.start_date) + 1

# Check duplicate ledger entry
existing = frappe.db.exists(
    "Leave Ledger Entry",
    {
        "transaction_type": "Forced Leave",
        "transaction_name": doc.name
    }
)

if not existing:

    ledger = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "Leave Ledger Entry",
        "transaction_type": "Forced Leave",
        "transaction_name": doc.name,
        "employee": doc.employee,
        "leave_type": "Forced Leave",
        "from_date": doc.start_date,
        "to_date": doc.end_date,
        "leaves": -total_days,
        "company": doc.company
    })

    ledger.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    ledger.submit()

    frappe.msgprint(
        str(total_days) + " day(s) of Forced Leave recorded.",
        indicator="green"
    )

name: Sync Notification Emails

Disciplinary Committee Composition
script: # Enforce REA disciplinary-panel composition based on the offender's grade. BAND = { "REA 3": "REA 2", "REA 4": "REA 3", "REA 5": "REA 4", "REA 6": "REA 4", "REA 7": "REA 4", "REA 8": "REA 4", "REA 9": "REA 4", "REA 10": "REA 4", } # Chairperson grade per offender grade (policy: REA 3 -> Director REA 2; REA 4 and REA 5+ -> Manager REA 3) CHAIR_BAND = { "REA 3": "REA 2", "REA 4": "REA 3", "REA 5": "REA 3", "REA 6": "REA 3", "REA 7": "REA 3", "REA 8": "REA 3", "REA 9": "REA 3", "REA 10": "REA 3", } BOARD_GRADES = ("REA 1", "REA 2") BOARD_ROLE = "Disciplinary Board Member" # REA 1 -> Board of Directors (Board Chairperson); REA 2 -> HR Board Committee (Committee Chairperson) CHAIR_ROLE = {"REA 1": "Board Chairperson", "REA 2": "HR Board Committee Chairperson"} HEARING_GATES = ("Disciplinary Committee", "Set Hearing Date") APPEAL_GATES = ("Set Appeal Date",) if doc.employee: grade = doc.custom_offender_grade or frappe.db.get_value("Employee", doc.employee, "grade") prev_state = None if doc.is_new() else frappe.db.get_value("Disciplinary", doc.name, "workflow_state") entering = doc.workflow_state != prev_state targets = [] if entering and doc.workflow_state in HEARING_GATES: targets.append((doc.hearing or [], "Disciplinary Committee")) if entering and doc.workflow_state in APPEAL_GATES: targets.append((doc.appeal_members or [], "Appeal Committee")) for rows, label in targets: members = [r for r in rows if (r.employee or r.get("custom_board_member"))] n = len(members) chairs = [r for r in members if (r.role_in_the_committee or "").strip() == "Chairperson"] # Secretary rows (committee role "Secretary", or a Secretary designation not sitting as Chair) # are non-adjudicating: exempt from the grade-band, odd-number and minimum-3 rules. secretaries = [r for r in members if (r.role_in_the_committee or "").strip() == "Secretary" or ("secretary" in (r.role or "").lower() and (r.role_in_the_committee or "").strip() != "Chairperson")] sec_names = [r.name for r in secretaries] voting = [r for r in members if r.name not in sec_names] n = len(voting) # --- REA 1 / REA 2: Board of Directors / HR Board Committee --- if grade in BOARD_GRADES: board_rows = [r for r in members if r.get("custom_board_member")] if not board_rows: frappe.throw(label + ": a " + grade + " matter must be heard by users holding the '" + BOARD_ROLE + "' role - fill the Board Member column.") not_registered = [] for r in board_rows: if not frappe.db.exists("Has Role", {"parent": r.custom_board_member, "parenttype": "User", "role": ["in", [BOARD_ROLE, CHAIR_ROLE[grade]]]}): not_registered.append(r.custom_board_member) if not_registered: frappe.throw(label + ": not registered as " + BOARD_ROLE + ": " + ", ".join(not_registered)) if len(chairs) != 1: frappe.throw(label + ": exactly one panel member must be marked as Chairperson (currently " + str(len(chairs)) + ").") chair_user = chairs[0].get("custom_board_member") if not chair_user or not frappe.db.exists("Has Role", {"parent": chair_user, "parenttype": "User", "role": CHAIR_ROLE[grade]}): frappe.throw(label + ": the Chairperson of a " + grade + " matter must be a user holding the '" + CHAIR_ROLE[grade] + "' role (Board Member column).") continue # --- REA 3 / REA 4 / REA 5 and below: Senior / Middle Management --- if grade not in BAND: continue band = BAND[grade] chair_band = CHAIR_BAND[grade] if n < 3: frappe.throw(label + ": a minimum of 3 members (excluding the Secretary) is required for a " + grade + " matter (currently " + str(n) + ").") if n % 2 == 0: frappe.throw(label + ": the panel must have an odd number of members, excluding the Secretary (currently " + str(n) + ").") if len(chairs) != 1: frappe.throw(label + ": exactly one member must be marked as Chairperson (currently " + str(len(chairs)) + ").") chair_name = chairs[0].name wrong = [] for r in voting: g = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", r.employee, "grade") if r.employee else None expected = chair_band if r.name == chair_name else band if g != expected: wrong.append((r.full_name or r.employee or "Board Member") + " (needs " + expected + ")") if wrong: frappe.throw(label + ": for a " + grade + " matter the Chairperson must be grade " + chair_band + " and the other members grade " + band + ". Not eligible: " + ", ".join(wrong)) # --- Exculpation Evaluation: supervisor must record the outcome --- exc_prev = None if doc.is_new() else frappe.db.get_value("Disciplinary", doc.name, "workflow_state") if exc_prev == "Exculpation Evaluation" and not doc.select_outcome: frappe.throw("Record whether the employee's exculpation was Satisfactory or Not Satisfactory before moving the case forward.") if doc.select_outcome == "Satisfactory" and doc.has_summary_dismissal: frappe.throw("A charge on this case carries a Summary Dismissal sanction, so the exculpation cannot be recorded as Satisfactory - the matter must proceed to a Disciplinary Hearing. Select Not Satisfactory.")

script:
employee = frappe.db.get_value(
    "Employee",
    {"user_id": frappe.session.user},
    "name"
)

if employee:
    employee = frappe.db.escape(employee)

    conditions = (
        "`tabDisciplinary`.employee != "
        + employee
        + """
        OR `tabDisciplinary`.workflow_state IN (
            'Issue Warning',
            'Issue Charge',
            'Awaiting Exculpation',
            'Exculpation Evaluation',
            'Recommend Disciplinary Hearing',
            'Disciplinary Committee',
            'Set Hearing Date',
            'Hearing Outcome',
            'Pending CEO Approval',
            'Awaiting Employee Decision',
            'Grounds for Appeal',
            'Appeal Under Review',
            'Appeal Requested',
            'Set Appeal Date',
            'Pending Outcome Approval',
            'Appeal Outcome',
            'Case Closed'
        )
        """
    )
else:
    conditions = "1=1"
